artworks.title: The Childhood of Pierre Clémenceau (L'Enfance de Pierre Clémenceau)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals sitting around a table in a dimly lit room. They are shown from the waist up, positioned closely together and engaged with each other. Their faces are partially visible due to the soft lighting and shadows. They have dark, shoulder-length hair and are wearing formal, dark-colored clothing. Two shaded lamps hanging above the table cast a warm glow around them. The room appears sparse with textured or grainy walls, with minimal detail visible.

artworks.title: Iza Sleeping (Le Sommeil d'Iza)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features two figures in a dimly lit, enclosed space. One figure is a woman reclining on a low surface, wearing flowing clothing. Beside her is a table with a lit candle. In the background, standing by an open curtain, is a man in a suit holding a round object. The setting includes heavy drapery, a framed picture, and a mirror reflecting light.

artworks.title: Iza Sleeping (Le Sommeil d'Iza)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a dimly lit room. The first person is seated in a large chair, dressed in period clothing. Beside them, there is a table with a lit candle. The second person is standing by a curtain, partially obscured, wearing formal attire and holding a hat. In the background, a doorway reveals more people in another room. The room is decorated with heavy curtains and a framed picture on the wall.

artworks.title: Iza Sleeping (Le Sommeil d'Iza)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on Arches laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals. In the foreground, a person is seated in an armchair. They have a youthful face, light-colored wavy hair, and wear historical clothing. There is a candle on a table beside them. In the background, another person stands in a doorway wearing a formal suit and holding a hat. The room is detailed with a mirror or picture on the wall, framed artworks, and heavy drapery. The lighting is provided by the candle.

artworks.title: The Murder (Le Meurtre)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person in a dark setting. The person has distinctive facial features and short, dark hair. They are reclining or seated, possibly leaning over someone else. Their arm is extended downward, holding an object close to them. The person is wearing loose-fitting fabric, and the surroundings indicate a cozy, intimate space. The background is filled with shadows, creating a mysterious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Carmen
artworks.medium: etching with roulette on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting and leaning forward with their right elbow resting on a surface, supporting their chin with their right hand. The person's facial features are sketchily drawn with a contemplative expression. They have short, wavy hair partially covering their forehead and are wearing a long-sleeved garment with a ring on their left ring finger. The background is simple, suggesting a softly drawn or etched environment.

artworks.title: The Rape (Le Viol)
artworks.medium: etching with graphite additions on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, partially visible from the lower legs upwards. The person on the left is leaning backward, holding onto a door with both hands while being embraced from behind by the second person. The first person has their head slightly turned away with a neat, low bun hairstyle. The second person, in a slightly right position, has a tousled hairstyle. Both individuals are wearing full-length garments. The setting includes a door behind them and a floor with visible tiling or parquet pattern lines.

artworks.title: The Rape (Le Viol)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: The Rape (Le Viol)
artworks.medium: etching on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures near a door, one figure appears to be pulling or restraining another. The line work is expressive with contrasts in shading. There is use of hatching and cross-hatching for texture. The drawing is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Nude Woman by a Looking Glass (Femme Nue Auprès d'une Glace)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two seated figures depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is displayed in profile, facing away from the viewer further into the background, with their head slightly bent forward. The figure on the right is seated facing more towards the viewer, with their left arm resting on a surface. This person has short, textured hair and indistinct facial features due to the drawing style, which uses dense cross-hatching to create shadows and depth. Both figures appear to be unclothed, and their sketch-like rendering conveys more of an impression rather than detailed realism. The background is composed of a textured surface with vertical and horizontal cross-hatchings, featuring a darker section behind the figures that enhances their visibility by contrast. No jewelry or objects are apparent in the image.

artworks.title: Nude Woman by a Looking Glass (Femme Nue Auprès d'une Glace)
artworks.medium: etching on green laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features two figures depicted from the waist up. Both figures are seated, with one facing forward and the other turned partially away. Their facial features are not detailed. The figure on the right has short hair, while the left figure's hair is indistinct. The figures appear nude, with no clothing visible. They are set against a crosshatched background. No jewelry or objects are present. The composition highlights the contrast between light and shadow on the figures and background.

artworks.title: Nude Woman by a Looking Glass (Femme Nue Auprès d'une Glace)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the waist up. The central figure faces forward with arms resting on a surface. Their face has delicate features and styled hair. The second figure on the left is slightly turned away. Both figures are unclothed, and there is no visible jewelry. The background has intricate crosshatched lines, suggesting an abstract setting.

artworks.title: Woman with a Vase (La femme au vase)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown with brown wash on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up in profile view. The person has long hair flowing over their shoulder. The clothing is obscured and blends with the dark, textured background. The person holds an object that appears to be a small container or dish. The background has a richly textured surface with possible floral arrangements or ornate patterns in muted tones. The composition is heavily shadowed, creating a mysterious and atmospheric effect.

artworks.title: Woman with a Vase (La femme au vase)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a person crouching and leaning forward while holding fabric. The person's upper torso to hands are in focus, as well as their subtle facial expressions and long hair. They wear a light-colored garment that drapes over their form. A bowl is in the foreground, and the background is dark with a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Woman with a Vase (La femme au vase)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a young person from the waist up, positioned in a kneeling pose. The person is facing slightly to the right while turning their head to look towards the viewer. They have long, straight hair that falls around their shoulders and are wearing a light-toned shirt with long sleeves. In their hands, they hold a piece of cloth or fabric. Nearby on the ground, there is a reflective bowl or basin. The background is textured and dark, possibly featuring a subtle pattern or etched design.

artworks.title: Robert de Montesquiou
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man leaning against a large stone urn. He is depicted from the torso up, with his body turned slightly towards the left. The man has distinguishable facial features including a pointed nose and a small mustache, with slicked-back hair. He is wearing a long coat or cloak draped over his shoulders and is holding a cigar in his left hand. The background features dense cross-hatching, depicting dark foliage and the suggestion of statues or pillars.

artworks.title: Madeleine Lemaire
artworks.medium: etching and printed tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts the stylized etching of a woman's upper body and face shown in two overlapping perspectives. On the left side, the woman's face and shoulders are seen frontally with shadows accentuating her features. She has short, dark hair and is wearing a high-collared garment with textured linework. The right side shows a continuation of the woman's torso, with her head slightly turned and a calm expression. Both sides feature detailed ruffled textures in her clothing. The background consists of swirling lines, adding a sense of movement, with no distinct scenery.

artworks.title: Neuilly Fair (La Foire de Neuilly)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a gathering under a dark canopy. It shows a group of figures under the distinctive structure, contrasting with a lightly shaded background that hints at a crowded outdoor setting. The style is reminiscent of James McNeill Whistler.

artworks.title: Seated Figure and a Cow; Three Studies of a Child's Head
artworks.medium: graphite, pen and brown ink on end papers of sketchbook cover
artworks.creditLine: The Armand Hammer Collection
artworks.description: The image consists of a sketch with two panels on a single sheet. The left panel shows partial drawings, including rough sketches of human bodies, with one figure in an upside-down horizontal position. There are no distinct facial features or hairstyles depicted on the figures. Handwritten text, numbers, "Nouregaard," "Copenhagen," and a faded business name label are present. The right panel features sketches of faces in profile and frontal views, showing minimal facial features with simple lines for eyes, nose, mouth, and hair. The style is loose and basic, indicating they may be studies or practice sketches. The background is a plain, light-colored paper surface with annotations on both panels. No clothing, jewelry, or specific objects are depicted.

artworks.title: Oedipe chez le Sphinx
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing with one leg slightly bent and looking upwards in a startled manner. The person has dark wavy hair, wide open eyes, and a slightly open mouth. They wear a long cloak, revealing their body, and carry a large sword across their chest. The ground is scattered with bones, and another figure to the right looks between rocks with a similar expression. The background features rocky textures, suggesting a cave or cavern.

artworks.title: Clémence de Minos
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two elderly figures. One is standing and the other is seated on a throne-like structure. The standing figure leans on a long stick and appears frail and contemplative. The seated figure wears a crown and is engrossed in reading a document. The scene suggests an interaction between a ruler and a subject. The background is softly shaded. The black and white colors with various shades of gray highlight textures and contrasts, emphasizing the difference in postures and expressions of the two characters.

artworks.title: An Elegant Woman with Her Hands Covering Her Eyes
artworks.medium: colored chalks on tracing paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image is a portrait drawing featuring a side profile of a person's upper body. The individual is positioned in such a way that only the head, neck, and shoulder area are visible, with the face turned to the side. The person's facial features are defined with delicate strokes, showcasing a prominent, softly shaded cheek and slightly colored lips. The hair appears to be swept back, depicted with flowing lines, and it has a light, airy texture that makes it seem voluminous. One of the person's hands is raised and rests softly on the side of the head, with delicate fingers lightly touching the forehead and surrounding the hair. The drawing is executed on a sheet of beige paper, which adds a warm tone to the composition. The sketches and shadings are created using a combination of color pencils or pastels, offering a range of colors from reds and blues to shades of black. The background is left unadorned, allowing the focus to remain on the artistic lines and the ethereal quality of the subject.

artworks.title: The Judgment of Paris
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a classical mythological scene set in a lush landscape. The scene includes several male and female figures, one of them seated and offering an object to a standing figure. There are elements such as flowing robes and decorated helmets typical of ancient Greco-Roman mythology. In the foreground, there are reclining figures in water, with one holding a jug from which water flows. The landscape features trees, winding paths through hills, and various animals like a bird and a dog. The textures and patterns show a skillful technique, and the composition blends human figures with the natural setting harmoniously.

artworks.title: Armorial Cartouche with Crown and Swags
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite, incised for transfer on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arthur L. Liebman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate emblem or crest. The drawing features a central oval shape, topped with a crown. The oval is surrounded by intricate decorations that include flowing ribbons and floral or leaf-like designs. The drawing is done in black and white, capturing the details with lines and shading. The background is plain.
